name: Claremont Foods
old_description: Founded in 2011, we are a family-owned food manufacturing company, based in Colorado, whose core focus is quality and excellence. We have built our business on a foundation of trust and transparency, to best serve our clients, our team members and our community. We are proud to say that our team is made up of talented individuals who are passionate about what they do and committed to our company values.
about:
Claremont Foods was founded in 2011 in Westminster, Colorado, as a family-owned food manufacturing company. The business was started by Alex (CEO), his wife Allison (Controller), and Alex’s two brothers, Adam (CFO) and Greg (Board Member). The family’s passion for healthy eating and commitment to quality and excellence shaped the company’s culture from the outset.

The company operates a 135,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility where it provides a full suite of services: product innovation and development, materials sourcing, production and manufacturing, and product quality management. In-house capabilities include bench-top formulations, raw-material sourcing, costing analysis, line trials on existing equipment, packaging design, and access to external consultants. The team specializes in developing and producing energy bars, protein bars, and nutrition bars, using a transparent, volume-based tolling pricing model.

Claremont serves well-established brands in the food and natural-products industries that have national distribution. Its client base includes companies seeking new product development, cost reduction through re-formulation, packaging modifications, or process improvements, and quality enhancement of existing products. The company positions itself as an extension of the brand’s manufacturing division, handling supply-chain management so clients can focus on marketing and sales.

The founders emphasize mutual success, trust, and transparency as core differentiators. Because the family owners are directly involved in daily operations, clients interact with decision makers. The location adjacent to Boulder County—known as the heart of the natural-products industry—provides access to collective expertise, resources, and emerging innovations. A quality-assurance department staffed by SQF- and PCQI-certified professionals oversees every production shift.
